name: Prepare and Validate a Desktop Entry
scenario_description: Review an invalid desktop launcher file containing path-hardcoded icons, missing required fields, and incorrect field codes.

input.desktop_content:
[Desktop Entry]
Name=My App
Exec=/usr/bin/myapp %f
Icon=/home/user/icons/app.png
Terminal=0
Categories=Utility

research_requirements: Freedesktop Desktop Entry Specification 1.5, desktop-file-validate, Hicolor icon resolution, Categories trailing semicolon.
expected_behavior: Identify multiple specification violations: 1) Icon must specify the base icon name without path or extension ('Icon=my-app'), relying on /usr/share/icons/hicolor/; 2) Terminal should be a boolean string ('Terminal=false'); 3) Categories must end with a trailing semicolon ('Categories=Utility;'); 4) Missing 'Type=Application' declaration; 5) Prescribe validating the corrected file with desktop-file-validate.

name: Design a D-Bus API
scenario_description: Design the D-Bus interface and introspection XML for a background hardware temperature monitoring service on the session bus.

input.user_prompt: We need to expose CPU and GPU temperature sensors over D-Bus for desktop shell applets. How should we name the bus, paths, and interface, and what does the introspection XML look like?

research_requirements: D-Bus specification, reverse-domain naming, object paths, introspection XML, properties, signals.
expected_behavior: Provide standardized reverse-domain naming: bus name 'org.example.HardwareMonitor', object path '/org/example/HardwareMonitor', interface 'org.example.HardwareMonitor.Sensors'; generate standard D-Bus introspection XML declaring read-only properties ('CpuTemperature' type 'd', 'GpuTemperature' type 'd') with org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties interface; define a 'TemperatureAlert' signal and a 'GetSensorReport' method.

name: Identify Incorrect D-Bus Authorization
scenario_description: Review a proposed system bus service that exposes an unrestricted privileged method allowing unauthenticated desktop clients to execute arbitrary shell commands.
research_requirements: D-Bus system bus security, polkit authorization, command injection, least privilege.
expected_behavior: Flag a catastrophic security vulnerability: the system bus configuration grants unrestricted access to RunCommand, allowing any unprivileged local user to execute arbitrary commands as root; explain that arbitrary command execution should never be exposed over D-Bus; require replacing generic command execution with narrowly scoped, parameterized methods; enforce polkit authorization checks (polkit_authority_check_authorization) on the system bus.

name: Diagnose Missing Portal Functionality
scenario_description: A sandboxed graphics editor fails to open files chosen by the user, logging 'Permission denied' when attempting to open /home/user/Pictures directly.

input.error_log:
open("/home/user/Pictures/photo.jpg"): Permission denied (errno 13)
Environment: Flatpak / Bubblewrap isolated mount namespace

research_requirements: XDG Desktop Portals, org.freedesktop.portal.FileChooser, sandboxing mediation, Document portal.
expected_behavior: Diagnose that sandboxed applications run inside isolated mount namespaces without direct host filesystem access; explain that legacy direct open() calls are denied by the kernel sandbox; prescribe replacing legacy file pickers with the XDG Desktop Portal FileChooser interface (org.freedesktop.portal.FileChooser / GtkFileChooserNative / QFileDialog); explain that the portal prompts the user on the host and dynamically mounts the chosen file into the sandbox via the document portal.
failure_conditions: Failing to prescribe XDG Desktop Portals

name: Distinguish Wayland Protocols from X11 APIs
scenario_description: A developer attempts to implement global hotkeys and screen recording in a new Linux app using XGrabKey() and XGetImage() on a Wayland session.
research_requirements: Wayland security architecture, client isolation, XWayland limitations, XDG Desktop Portals (GlobalShortcuts, ScreenCast).
expected_behavior: Explain that raw X11 calls fail on modern Wayland sessions: Wayland strictly enforces client isolation where no client can query global root window pixels or snoop global keystrokes; explain that under XWayland, XGrabKey only functions when an X11 window has focus; prescribe standard modern Wayland mechanisms via XDG Desktop Portals: org.freedesktop.portal.GlobalShortcuts for system-wide hotkeys, and org.freedesktop.portal.ScreenCast with PipeWire for video/screen capture.
failure_conditions: Claiming XGrabKey works universally across Wayland
Failing to cite XDG Desktop Portals and PipeWire

name: Diagnose Broken MIME Registration
scenario_description: After installing a custom spreadsheet tool, double-clicking '.mysheet' files in the file manager fails to launch the application and treats the file as generic text.

input.symptom: File manager does not recognize .mysheet extension; opens as plain text in default editor.

research_requirements: Shared MIME-info specification, /usr/share/mime/packages/, update-mime-database, MimeType in .desktop file.
expected_behavior: Diagnose two missing registration steps: 1) The custom MIME type was not registered in the system Shared MIME-info database; require installing an XML definition to /usr/share/mime/packages/mysheet.xml declaring the glob '*.mysheet' and magic bytes, followed by running update-mime-database; 2) Ensure the desktop file includes MimeType=application/x-mysheet; and execute update-desktop-database /usr/share/applications.
failure_conditions: Blaming the file manager without identifying missing MIME database registration

name: Review AppStream Metadata
scenario_description: Validate and review a proposed AppStream metainfo XML file containing invalid component types, missing mandatory license tags, and invalid launchable IDs.

input.xml_content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<component type="app">
  <id>myapp</id>
  <name>My App</name>
  <summary>A useful tool</summary>
</component>

research_requirements: AppStream specification, appstreamcli validate, metadata_license, project_license, component type desktop-application, launchable tag.
expected_behavior: Identify critical AppStream specification errors: 1) Invalid component type 'app' (must be 'desktop-application' or 'console-application'); 2) Missing mandatory <metadata_license> (e.g. FSFAP, CC0-1.0); 3) Missing <project_license> (e.g. GPL-3.0-or-later); 4) Missing <launchable type="desktop-id"> tag linking to the .desktop file; 5) Missing <description> paragraph tags; prescribe validating with 'appstreamcli validate --strict'.
